question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region,
        COUNT(o.id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name AS region,
        sr.name AS sales_rep,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_region r
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
    JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sales_rep,
        rep_total_sales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY rep_total_sales DESC) AS rnk
    FROM rep_sales
)
SELECT 
    rt.region,
    COALESCE(CAST(rt.num_orders AS BIGINT), 0) AS num_orders,
    COALESCE(ROUND(rt.total_sales, 2), 0) AS total_sales,
    rt2.sales_rep,
    COALESCE(ROUND(rt2.rep_total_sales, 2), 0) AS sales_rep_sales_amount
FROM top_reps rt2
JOIN region_totals rt ON rt2.region = rt.region
WHERE rt2.rnk = 1
ORDER BY rt.region, rt2.sales_rep;
